description: Use when you must screen several sites for natural hazards at once: up to 10 'lat,lon' points in one POST, each answered exactly like /hazards/near. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (POST /hazards/near/batch, $0.05 per call; schema linked). POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For a single site use hazards_near. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

days.description: optional, for every site: look-back days, 1..30

km.description: optional, for every site: radius in km for earthquakes and EONET events (NWS alerts are for the point itself), 1..500

name: hazards_near_batch
title: Hazards near batch
